states.name: default
states.description: Static app name/logo heading, always visible
visual_cues: bold app name text at top of the card

states.name: default
states.description: Empty or valid, no error shown

states.name: invalid
states.description: Empty on submit, or doesn't look like an email
visual_cues: inline validation message below the field
states.condition: field is empty on submit attempt, or value has no '@' followed by more characters

interactions.response: clears the invalid state if the new value now looks like an email

validation.when: submit attempted with an empty value
submit attempted with a value that has no '@' or nothing after it

states.name: revealed
states.description: Characters shown in plain text after toggling visibility
states.condition: password-toggle-button was clicked and is in its pressed state

states.name: invalid
visual_cues: inline validation message below the field
states.condition: field is empty on submit attempt

interactions.response: clears the invalid state if the new value is non-empty

validation.when: submit attempted with an empty value

states.name: default
states.description: Password is masked, icon shows an open eye (click to reveal)

states.name: pressed
states.description: Password is revealed, icon shows a crossed-out eye (click to mask again)

interactions.response: toggles password-input between masked and revealed

accessibility.keyboard: activates on Enter and Space, like any button

states.name: loading
states.description: Request in flight — disabled to prevent double submission
visual_cues: spinner replaces or accompanies the label
states.condition: a login request has been sent and no response has arrived yet

interactions.response: runs client-side validation on email-input and password-input first; if both are valid, sends the login request and enters the loading state; on success redirects to /dashboard; on failure shows login-error-message with the appropriate message

states.name: default
states.description: Always visible below the submit button

interactions.response: no-op for now — out of scope for this view, per the description

states.name: hidden
states.description: No error to show — the default state on first load and after any successful field correction

states.name: visible-invalid-credentials
states.description: Login failed because the email/password combination was wrong
states.condition: the login request failed with an invalid-credentials response, and the account isn't locked

states.name: visible-account-locked
states.description: Login failed because the account has been locked after too many failed attempts
visual_cues: red/error-colored text: "This account has been locked due to too many failed attempts. Contact support."
states.condition: the login request failed with an account-locked response
